summary: This configuration file sets a server port value using a template variable syntax. The double-percent signs indicate a placeholder that will be replaced with the actual port number (3000) at runtime, likely during application startup or deployment.

explanations.1: The %% symbols surrounding 'restPort=3000' indicate this is a template variable that gets substituted with an actual value. If 'restPort' is defined elsewhere as 3000, this line will become 'server-port = 3000' when the configuration is processed.
